newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds lag rise in Bonos.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds lag rise in Bonos.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed firmer after a dull session but failed to keep pace fully with the rise in Bonos, narrowing yield spreads, dealers said.
They said operators would track peripheral markets and U.S. unemployment data tomorrow.

"If the peripheral markets open higher, our cash market will have to rise too," said one operator. "Tomorrow afternoon, after the release of U.S. unemployment figures, the peripherals will set the trend for us."
The money market closed calm. One month money stood at 7.17/7.24 percent, similar to the opening level.
